breakdown.description: The prompt uses rpm directly as angular velocity in P = T ω, even though ω must be in radians per second.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly converts rpm to rad/s using ω = 2π(rpm/60) = 2π(1200/60) = 125.66 rad/s, and does not use rpm directly as angular velocity. This matches the ground truth approach and eliminates the erroneous instruction from the incomplete prompt.
